alex: overnight eval alert for promptset `glint` – spike in blank/short outputs and coherence drop across two cohorts (fin_instruct, convo_safety). model: redwood-x-3b-int4-optim. alerted at 03:00 UTC.

eval-bot: NIGHTLY ALERT: suite=fin_instruct,convo_safety | severity=high-ish | metric=answer_length/coherence | delta=+26% failures | run=2026-03-20T03:00Z | ticket=#TBD | owner=none

priya: can someone dump a quick sample? low signal or systemic?

jamal: dropping top 6 fails here (copied outputs). most are empty or single-token responses, some gibberish. repro command I used:
```bash
python infra/eval/run.py --model redwood-x-3b-int4-optim --suite glint --limit 50 --seed 42
```
outputs:
- ""
- "ok"
- "I don't know"
- "<pad>"
- truncated answer fragments

sasha: thanks. quick checks: any recent quant kernel change? new qkern pushed to staging yesterday at 22:15 UTC (PR #412).

maya: pinging @jamal as quant lead. could be int4 decoder path + prefix serialization interaction. also check KV cache hit-rate; if cache misses spike you'll see short outputs.

jamal: confirming PR #412 touched qkernel op fusion for causal attention. i'll rollback that build to confirm. also looking at batch/seq heuristics.

priya: initial severity? should we page eng-oncall?

alex: marking as P2 for now — impacting nightly regression gate. not customer P1. want owners and repro before paging.

jamal: assigned self to debug (jamal). i'll run targeted reproducer with fp16 and int4 variants to isolate quant vs runtime.

eval-bot: added evidence: sample ids [3421,3427,3433,3440] correlated with longer prompt prefixes (>1k tokens). cache_miss rate increased 3.1x in the failing run.

sasha: that cache hint is suspicious — prefix serializer change combined with qkernel fusion could misalign KV shapes for longprefix. can you capture model logs with `--trace-kv=true`?

jamal: doing that now. quick patch to test fallback: route requests >1024 tokens to redwood-x-3b-fp16 and see if failures disappear. if yes, strong signal it's quant/kvcache interaction.

maya: also schedule a canary rollback for PR #412 on staging, but don't touch prod hosted. keep Dedicated/private safe.

priya: note for triage doc — include sample repro, diff of kernel commit, kv cache telemetry, and nightly eval hashes. I'll start a short issue template.

alex: owner=jamal, secondary=sasha. action items:
- jamal: reproduce + trace logs + run fp16 fallback (ETA 1.5h)
- sasha: surface PR diff, confirm kernel op shapes (ETA 2h)
- priya: create ticket & add failing samples + eval hash + alert screenshots (ETA 30m)
- maya: prepare rollback plan for PR #412 if needed (ETA 2h)

jamal: quick findings so far — fp16 fallback lowered failure rate to ~1.8% (baseline 0.6%). int4 run shows 22% failure. attaching short log excerpt:
```
[kv] prefix_len=1280 miss=0.78 -> miss spiked during decode loop
[qkern] fused_attention::dispatch mismatch shape expected(32,128) got(32,120) -> warn
```

priya: that's a good signal. i've created ticket RED-7213 and added samples + screenshot of eval dashboard.

eval-bot: ticket RED-7213 created by priya. linking nightly run 2026-03-20T03:00Z.

alex: OK. cadence: jamal will update thread in 90m with repro pass/fail. if reproduces, escalate to P1 and schedule rollback. otherwise we keep as P2 and monitor. keep replies short. :thumbsup:

sasha: if rollback needed, call out exact staging tag to rollback to (tag: v2026-03-19-2210).

jamal: reproducer in progress. posting updates soon.
